entities.name: A6VQ84 EpmA
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt A6VQ84 from Actinobacillus succinogenes; 323 aa.
EpmA works with EpmB to attach (R)-β-lysine to a conserved lysine on EF-P; reference annotation describes ATP-dependent activation and transfer.
Reference annotation reports homodimerization; this is database annotation, not established from the query sequence analysis itself.

entities.name: Elongation factor P
observations: Target of EpmA/EpmB-dependent β-lysylation at a conserved lysine residue.
